owner_instruction: Freeze mass BLK/KK text generation until the ontology, per-LT-PIX worksheet, exception registry, and review gate are locked.
reason: Near-perfect BLK/KK work requires complete source coverage, controlled uncertainty, and human structural listening rather than fixed-window or high-speed slicing.

blocked: mass or batch BLK/KK text candidate creation
mass CC extraction that could be mistaken for BLK structure
automated promotion of mass-created CC candidates
automated internal approval decisions for mass-created KK candidates
allowed: one LT-PIX worksheet at a time
work needed to lock the four prerequisites

status_vocabulary.TRIAGE: Evidence exists, but the authority join, structural identity, boundary proof, or review proof is incomplete. Preserve the uncertainty; do not guess a section label.
status_vocabulary.STAGE: Every required source, lyric, sequential BLK, boundary, vocal, delivery, playback, pricing, and human-review proof is complete. STAGE is never an uncertainty state.
status_vocabulary.HOLD: A deliberate hard stop for a known conflict, unsafe use, disqualified object, missing required authority source, or owner-directed stop. HOLD is not the ordinary incomplete-evidence state.
status_vocabulary.HOLD_NOT_BLK: A hard disqualification applied to legacy fixed clock windows so they cannot be represented as BLKs. A new authoritative BLK record may be created only after complete structural proof.

legacy_window_rule.promotion_rule: Never relabel a legacy window in place. Create a separately proven BLK record from authorized lyric and audio evidence.
